authorization.humanSelection: Add restrained aftermath at 3–4 other key locations (Recommended)
authorization.coordinatorScope: Exactly THREE new sites: arrival, infirmary and archive. Existing maintenance and human-approved e26 responder/two maps remain frozen.
authorization.status: Authorized execution and immutable handoff; parent/user review of one actual-game view per new site remains required.

construction: One new world-origin GLB, three named site nodes with separate floor-trace children. Compact merged indexed geometry, original existing materials and selected existing atlas regions only. No texture file is generated, modified, recompressed or downscaled.

stories.arrival-aftermath: Interrupted retreat at the arrival area's east pressure panel: scored removable cover, one torn attachment/dark contact recess and a terminating dirty wipe. Secondary short rub leaves the panel. No repeated full handprint or blood blanket.
stories.infirmary-aftermath: Failed aid at an existing folded berth: a thickened frayed wrap caught in a bent clip, one absorbed contact patch following the cloth surface, and a slack restraint tail. No body, new collider or standing furnishing.
stories.archive-aftermath: A short brace forced across recorder equipment, not across a passage: opposing seated contacts, a sheared mounting ear and split cassette lip with sparse residue/scoring. No doorway barricade or loose polygon clutter.

preservation: All 75 prior runtime files byte-identical, including existing maintenance GLB, all maps, final ending, audio, facility, gas giant, windows and hull.
No authoritative scene/entity/AI/control/door/collider/LOS/input/lighting changes. Presentation-only objects, never scene entities.
Raised geometry stays in the owner-provided existing-solid envelopes, with at most14mm visual lip. Floor traces stay at3–5mm. Protected control approach rectangles and door sweeps remain clear.
No new generation, model installation, engine feature, dialogue, score, corpse, exposed anatomy or weapon.
No actor or old-cluster recapture; integrator captures one representative actual-input view per new site.
materialProvenance: Original authored geometry reuses the already-declared ceramic, graphite, metal and cloth-normal resources plus existing aftermath atlas crops. Actor-specific stain maps are not reused. Existing source/provenance rights remain unchanged; no CC0 or new AI-output claim.
validation: Exact baseline scene/inventory/dependency hashes; all raised/floor/protected rectangle checks; actual cooked new-mesh ray hits compared with current facility geometry, not projection alone; strict unique-byte cap and production closure; deterministic second build.
gate: One sealed environment-only exact-preimage handoff against current75/e26. Stop after handoff; no further site expansion or art edits until parent/user review.
